newsitem.title: UK: Budget last gasp of fading government - UK's Blair.
newsitem.headline: Budget last gasp of fading government - UK's Blair.

text.p: Opposition Labour leader Tony Blair on Tuesday described the budget just announced by Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke as "the last gasp budget of a government whose time is up".
Reacting to Clarke's measures in Parliament, Blair said the budget would do nothing to tackle the fundamental British problems of an unequal society and an undereducated workforce.
"This is actually the last gasp budget of a government whose time is up, which can't be trusted with the future and can't make amends for the past," Blair said.
He said Labour had heard government promises to cut taxes at the last election and had not believed them.
"The difference this time is that the country now doesn't believe them either," he said.
"The truth is -- 17-18 years of one government -- there are no excuses left." -- London Newsroom +44 171 5424084
